annotations.title: Company car tax (bijtelling) in the Netherlands

description: The yearly addition to income (bijtelling) for private use of a company car in the Netherlands in 2026, for electric and fuel cars (with the 60-month lock-in of an electric car's rate and cap from its first registration), and the extra income tax at the employee's marginal rate.

catalog_value.description: The car's list price (catalogue value incl. BPM and VAT), euros

first_registration_year.description: Year the car was first registered (sets an electric car's rate for 60 months). Default 2026.

taxable_income.description: Taxable income before the bijtelling, euros a year. Default 60000.
